desc: A small building as a massing study. Big volumes survive; openings do not become holes.
source_prompt: a single detached two-storey house, pitched roof, one rectangular chimney, four windows, one front door, flat plain walls, the whole building inside the frame with margin on all sides, three-quarter corner view, flat mid-grey seamless background, even frontal light, no cast shadow, no garden, no fence, no trees, no cars, no sky
output: untextured GLB mesh, POSITION attribute only, ~525k tris, ~8.5 MB, 19.5 s
usable_for: massing study, scale and proportion check, distant background building, blockout
not_usable_for: any use needing an interior, real window and door openings, or straight true edges. Not a game asset - needs retopology, UVs and texture bake.
note: Windows and doors come back as shallow recesses in a continuous surface, not as cut apertures - the model reconstructs an outer shell and there is no interior behind it. Do not plan to walk a camera inside. Surface net also rounds every corner slightly, so a building that must read as crisp architecture will need its edges rebuilt by hand. Massing and silhouette are what you actually get.
